facts.fact: Youm7 says the Ministry of Communications and IT launched a "cloud first" policy.
Youm7 says the Ministry of Communications and IT issued laws including one on personal data protection; commencement is not stated.
Youm7 says the ministry attracted nine global mobile phone makers with local manufacturing above 40%, and three fibre optic cable factories are operating.

EGY.note: Only a lower minimum capital for one-person companies; no startup law, labelling or fund stated.

facts.fact: Youm7 says the ministry set up 24 Digital Egypt Creativa centres in the governorates to support startups with incubation and training, with partners Plug and Play and 500 Global.
Youm7 says the 24 Digital Egypt Creativa centres are spread across the governorates.
